explanation.headline: FDA lists ifosfamide injection as a current shortage first posted 2026-06-12 with no public signal at our plants

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows ifosfamide injection as Current with an initial posting date of 2026-06-12 and updates through 2026-10-16.
The shortage covers products from Baxter Healthcare, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., and SteriMax Inc.
No FDA inspection classification or public signal is recorded for the plants supplying our Corvale sites.
Corvale East holds 9 vials of the 50 mg/mL 60 mL presentation at 3.5 vials per day, giving 2.6 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 19 vials of the same presentation at 0.7 vials per day, giving 26.5 days on hand.
The top-ranked action is to transfer 8 vials of 50 mg/mL 60 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East, which would leave Lakeside with 15 days and bring East to 5 days.
Alternate concentration options approved by P&T include Hikma's 50 mg/mL (approved 2026-09-15) and Baxter's 1 g/20 mL (approved 2026-04-18), both requiring pharmacist verification.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
